about.title: About Prince George's County Public Schools
about.content: Prince George's County Public Schools, also known as PGCPS, serves families in Prince George's County, Maryland, in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. The district calendar is the primary source for countywide school-year planning across elementary, middle, and high school communities.

about.title: How to Use This PGCPS Calendar
about.content: Use this page for PGCPS school calendar planning, including the first day of school, Student Orientation Day, early dismissal dates, professional development days, parent-teacher conferences, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, inclement weather make-up days, quarter end dates, and the last day for students. Families should verify school-specific events, athletics, testing, graduations, and program calendars directly with PGCPS.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for PGCPS Families
content: Student Orientation Day is listed before the first day for all students, so families should check whether their child is expected to attend on that date.
PGCPS lists several early dismissal days for teacher professional half-days and grading and reporting half-days.
The calendar includes designated inclement weather make-up days that may become instructional days if emergencies disrupt the school year.
Religious observances are noted for planning purposes; families should check PGCPS guidance for attendance, accommodations, and school-specific schedule impacts.

customSections.label: About PGCPS Calendar Structure
customSections.content: The PGCPS school calendar separates student attendance days from professional duty days, professional development days, early dismissal days, grading and reporting days, parent-teacher conference days, holidays, religious observances, and inclement weather make-up days. The calendar also identifies quarter end dates and notes that the final student and teacher days may change if make-up days are needed.

customSections.label: Does the PGCPS Calendar Apply to All Schools?
customSections.content: The PGCPS district calendar is the source for countywide dates such as the first day, last day, breaks, holidays, early dismissals, professional development days, parent-teacher conferences, and make-up days. Individual schools may still publish separate dates for athletics, testing windows, graduations, ceremonies, field trips, and program-specific schedules, so families should check both the district calendar and their assigned school calendar before making final plans.

districtFaqs.q: Which Prince George's County Public Schools calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official PGCPS 2026-2027 school year calendar for districtwide student and family planning.

districtFaqs.q: Does the PGCPS calendar apply to all schools?
districtFaqs.a: The district calendar covers countywide PGCPS dates such as the first day, last day, holidays, early dismissals, professional development days, and make-up days. Individual schools may publish separate event, testing, athletics, graduation, or program calendars.

districtFaqs.q: What are PGCPS inclement weather make-up days?
districtFaqs.a: Inclement weather make-up days are dates PGCPS may use as instructional days if schools close for emergencies. The 2026-2027 calendar identifies April 19, June 16, and June 17, 2027 as possible make-up days.

districtFaqs.q: Does the PGCPS calendar include religious holidays?
districtFaqs.a: The PGCPS calendar notes major religious holidays and observances for planning purposes. Families should review district guidance for closures, professional development days, and accommodations.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify PGCPS calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official PGCPS calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Prince George's County Public Schools.
